name: v07-ideas-admin

checks.name: five columns with their counts (New 2, Accepted 1, In progress 2, Done 1, Rejected 1)
the record with an unknown status is counted, not placed
the old Reports tab is gone
the mail setup line names the sender
drag to Accepted sends one POST ideas/update {id, status: accepted}
drop on its own column sends nothing
ArrowLeft in New sends nothing (edge)
ArrowRight on the handle moves the card to the next column
the focus stays on the moved card's handle
Done opens the thank-you dialog at "what was done", after one status call and no e-mail
"Make the e-mail" with nothing written sends nothing
the summary goes in the pilot's language to ideas/done, and the server's draft is shown
the draft is addressed to the pilot's e-mail
the draft is only a draft (nothing queued)
Not now sends nothing and leaves the draft a draft
the card reopens the waiting draft without a call
Send queues the thank-you once (ideas/send-done {id, mail: the draft read})
the owner is told the thank-you is queued and when it goes
after it the card no longer offers a thank-you
a refused move leaves the card in its column and says why
Done for a note without an e-mail opens no thank-you dialog
search keeps only the card with every word
a word found nowhere empties the board
kind toggles: only bugs left
contact filter: the cards without a contact
Details opens the card in a modal side panel, 720 px wide at 1280, the focus in it
while the panel is open the focus is not on the board (control for the return below)
technical details open from the card (the stored JSON)
technical details download as R-20261008-0003.json
the card shows what the pilot sent (language, page, scene, release)
no e-mail left: no reply box, a reason instead
Esc closes the panel and the focus is back on the card's Details
Close closes it too, the focus on the same Details
the contact itself is on the card
the four public titles each get the panel's width (> 600 px) and show their words whole
a refused reply keeps its text in the box
the reply is queued behind the undo window and the owner is told so
after the send the reply box is empty
a second click on Send reply sends nothing: the pilot gets one e-mail
Cancel on the queued reply stops it
after Add comment the comment box is empty (a second click adds nothing)
the panel stays open across the server's answers (redrawn in place, the same card)
reply, cancel, comment, urgency and public title each send their own call with their body
the Column select moves the card (touch)
a card with an English title in a shown status carries the landing chip
without an English title no landing chip
the card asks for the English title first, then names the languages still missing
Enter in a public title adds no line break
the unticked landing switch survives closing the panel and redraws before Save
Save sends visible: false and the card leaves the landing
an empty note sends nothing
the note goes to ideas/note and lands in New
without Gmail a reply is announced as saved for Gmail, not as queued
the thank-you dialog opens over the open panel (a move to Done from its Column select)
without Gmail the thank-you is announced as saved for Gmail, not as queued
the card reopens that thank-you to Send: no new draft, no Edit, its state said
its Send goes to ideas/mail/send with that e-mail: one thank-you, queued, no longer offered
after the thank-you dialog the focus is back in the open panel
a newer summary replaced the open draft on the server (draft 1 superseded)
Send under the replaced draft: send-done {id, mail: draft 1} is refused, nothing is queued
the dialog re-reads the idea and shows the current draft with a warning
the next Send queues the current draft, draft 1 stays superseded
the superseded draft offers no Send and no Cancel on the card
the queued one does (control)
a refused Cancel (409) re-reads the card: the e-mail shows as sent, without Cancel, and the owner is told why
at 375 px the board is one column with no sideways scroll
at 375 px the open card takes the whole screen width, nothing sideways
another card opens at the top of the panel, not where the last one was scrolled
with the store readable there is no store message (control)
a move while ideas.json is unreadable: the board gives way to a plain reason with Try again
opening the Ideas tab while the store is unreadable says so, no page error
Try again while it is still unreadable keeps the reason (control)
Try again once the file reads again brings the board back
the Scenes tab still opens
no page errors
no e-mail went out on its own: three thank-yous queued by Send (one then sent by the outbox), one draft superseded, one reply cancelled, one waiting for Gmail

publicTitle.en: A crosshair in the centre of the view

replyWithoutGmail: Reply to pilot.one@example.com saved but not sent: Gmail is not set up on the server. Once it is, press Send next to it on the card.
thanksWithoutGmail: Thank-you to pilot.one@example.com saved but not sent: Gmail is not set up on the server. Once it is, press Send next to it on the card.

staleSend.note: A newer draft replaced the one that was open. Read it, then press Send again.

changedMeanwhile: This e-mail changed meanwhile (another tab, Telegram or an agent). The card now shows it as it is.
storeDown: The ideas file on the server cannot be read right now, so the board cannot be shown or changed. Nothing is lost and nothing was changed; the Scenes tab works. An agent can check data/ideas.json on the server, then press Try again.Try again
